[{"node": "menu_content107", "element": "menu_content", "data": {"label": "Administration", "key": "administration_menu_content", "id": "administration_menu_content", "name": "administration_menu_content"}, "elements": [{"node": "markdown101", "element": "markdown", "data": {"label": "Restaurant Settings", "key": "md_restaurant_settings", "id": "restaurant-settings", "name": "md_restaurant_settings", "value": "# Restaurant Settings

| Option | What it does |
|---|---|
| Default Role | The role of people with none set in their POS Profile |
| Staff must clock in to take orders | Orders need an open shift |
| PIN login on registered terminals | Switch user with a PIN at /pos_login |
| Sell only items on the menu | Refuse items that aren't on the menu in force |
| Card Payments | Stripe Terminal key and readers |

The statuses used by production flows are in the **Status Order PC** list (see **Kitchen**). Reservation rules are per restaurant, in **Restaurant Reservation Settings**.
"}}, {"node": "markdown102", "element": "markdown", "data": {"label": "POS Profile · Restaurant tab", "key": "md_pos_profile_restaurant_tab", "id": "pos-profile-restaurant-tab", "name": "md_pos_profile_restaurant_tab", "value": "# POS Profile · Restaurant tab

| Field | What it does |
|---|---|
| Restaurant | The restaurant this till belongs to |
| Tips Account | Liability account for tips. Empty = no tips |
| Suggested Tips (%) | e.g. `18, 20, 22` |
| Calculate Tip On | Subtotal or total with tax |
| Receipt Printer | Bills, receipts and the cash drawer |
| Print Kitchen Tickets on Send | Tickets to the centers' printers |
| Print Receipt After Payment | Automatic receipt |
| Open Cash Drawer on Cash Payments | Drawer kick with the receipt |
"}}, {"node": "markdown103", "element": "markdown", "data": {"label": "Options, sizes and combos", "key": "md_options_sizes_and_combos", "id": "options-sizes-and-combos", "name": "md_options_sizes_and_combos", "value": "# Options, sizes and combos

In the **Restaurant** tab of an item: **Options** (components Included or Optional, and instructions), **Sections** (rules: minimum, maximum, free choices, ingredient modes, shared **Option Lists**) and **Price from Components**. Sizes are ERPNext **Item Variants**: set the options on the template. Create **Option Lists** for what many items share (cooking point, sauces). See **Combos**.
"}}, {"node": "markdown104", "element": "markdown", "data": {"label": "Printers", "key": "md_printers", "id": "printers", "name": "md_printers", "value": "# Printers

Create a **Restaurant Printer** with the printer's IP address (port 9100), paper width and copies, and press **Print Test**. The server running ERPNext must reach the printer on the network. Every print is a **Print Job** you can review and send again.
"}}, {"node": "markdown105", "element": "markdown", "data": {"label": "Card payments", "key": "md_card_payments", "id": "card-payments", "name": "md_card_payments", "value": "# Card payments

In **Restaurant Settings → Card Payments**, enable Stripe Terminal, paste your secret key and add each reader (`tmr_…`) with the payment method it records (e.g. *Credit Card*) and its POS Profile. Use a test key first: a simulated reader lets you try the whole flow.
"}}, {"node": "markdown106", "element": "markdown", "data": {"label": "Voids and audit", "key": "md_voids_and_audit", "id": "voids-and-audit", "name": "md_voids_and_audit", "value": "# Voids and audit

Voids of items already sent need the *Void sent items* permission or a manager PIN, and a reason (configurable in **Restaurant Void Reason**). Every void is recorded in the **Void Log**: who, what, why, the kitchen status and the server who took the order. Other sensitive actions go to the **Restaurant Audit Log** (see **Permissions**).
"}}]}]
